name: editFile
description: Edit content of a file. If you need to edit multiple places in a file or across multiple files, you should issue multiple tool calls simultaneously, rather than in series.

workpiece.description: Env binding name of the workpiece (e.g. gadget) that owns the file, as listed in the system prompt or chosen in createGadget.

filename.description: Name of the file to edit.

textToReplace.description: Exact existing text which is to be replaced. This string must match exactly one location in the file, or the edit will fail.

replacement.description: Text which should be inserted, replacing the matched text.
